arxiv-2003-05425.description: Abstract A common approach to define convolutions on meshes is to interpret them as a graph and apply graph convolutional networks (GCNs). arxiv-2109-05493.creator: Ryoya Katafuchi, Terumasa Tokunaga
arxiv-2109-05493.description: Abstract Abstract The utilization of prior knowledge about anomalies is an essential issue for anomaly detections. Recently, the visual attention mechanism has become a promising way to improve the performance of CNNs for some computer vision tasks. In this paper, we propose a novel model called Layer-wise External Attention Network (LEA-Net) for efficient image anomaly detection.

arxiv-2209-14315.creator: Avishai Gilkis and Tomer Shenar
arxiv-2209-14315.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Avishai Gilkis and Tomer Shenar. Upsilon Sagittarii is a hydrogen-deficient binary that has been suggested to be in its second stage of mass transfer, after the primary has expanded to become a helium supergiant following core helium exhaustion. A tentative identification of the faint companion in the ultraviolet led to mass estimates of both components that made the helium star in Upsilon Sagittarii a prototypical immediate progenitor of a type Ib/c supernova.

arxiv-2406-18435.title: Upper Bounds on the Mass of Fundamental Fields from Primordial Universe
arxiv-2406-18435.creator: Hassan Firouzjahi
arxiv-2406-18435.description: Abstract We study the fluctuations in the vacuum zero point energy associated to quantum fields and their statistical distributions during inflation. It is shown that the perturbations in the vacuum zero point energy have large amplitudes which are highly non-Gaussian. The effects of vacuum zero point fluctuations can be interpreted as the loop corrections in primordial power spectrum and bispectrum.

arxiv-2601-04718.title: CP, or not CP, that is the question …
arxiv-2601-04718.description: Abstract Motivated by recent claims questioning the existence of strong CP violation, we present a pedagogical review of CP violation in Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD). Using fundamental properties of the QCD partition function, we analyze the dependence of the chiral quark and CP violating gluon condensates on the θ \theta parameter and the quark masses in the chiral limit.

pmc-10594504.description: Urinary tract infections are among the most prevalent types of healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) in hospitals and nursing homes, and they are primarily a result of unnecessary catheter usage and inadequate care.
